accuracy_interpretation: oracle_step_acc uses injected synthetic pose. It verifies temporal-model and protocol integration only, not end-to-end camera-to-pose accuracy. sequence_complete / skip_detected / recovery_hold_at_expected_step / recovery_confirmed / sequence_complete_after_correction come from evaluate_state_machine()'s scripted, perfect-confidence, directly-injected predictions (see feed()) — they verify state_machine.py's own hold/recovery logic is correct, not that the deployed camera->pose->LSTM pipeline reliably produces a clean, confident prediction stream from real inference.
